one_sentence_story: Scientists filmed humans sleeping in total darkness and caught their pupils shrinking before protective sleep waves and widening up to 35% during secret brainstem surges you never remember.
so_what_for_you: Waking up tired after a full night can happen because hidden brainstem arousal waves repeatedly re-open your brain's sensory gate in tiny pulses rather than leaving you in deep rest all night.
